cohort: 71 parturients with a gestational age of 37 1/7-41 5/7 weeks, including 36 with SARS-CoV-2 infection and 35 healthy controls
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection during labor and delivery significantly increased the risk of placental lesions, including vascular and inflammatory abnormalities, although it did not significantly impact perinatal acidosis or cesarean section rates.
